name: Chemical Engineering Laboratory-II
description: Demonstrate principles and applications of Mass Transfer and Fluid Particle Mechanics through experiments. Topics covered include: estimation of diffusion coefficient and mass transfer coefficient, vapour-liquid equilibria, separation processes, and humidification operations, flow through packed bed and fluidized bed, Blaine's apparatus, estimation of drag coefficient, sedimentation analysis, sieve analysis, and particulate separation processes.
